Hi Margo —

Hope you’re well. As we discussed on the renewal call, we’d like to schedule a focused QBR (30–45m) combining the renewal review + a short roadmap demo that’s relevant to your inference cost and latency plans. To make booking easy, can you confirm which of these windows work on your side (all PT):

- Tue Jun 29 — 9:00–9:45 or 10:30–11:15
- Thu Jul 1 — 9:00–9:45 or 1:00–1:45

If none of those fit, please suggest two alternatives next week and tell us who from Clearline should be present (technical lead, procurement, CISO if security is required).

Attached is the QBR-Agenda-v2.pdf — short agenda and the one-page checklist for the demo. Two asks from your side if possible:
- Confirm the primary success metric for the demo (latency at p95, cost/unit, or throughput).
- Let us know if there are any network/firewall restrictions or a vendor contact we should work with in advance.

We’ll hold tentative spots in Marissa’s calendar until we hear back. Thanks — looking forward to getting this on the books.

Best,
Irene
